Mutual Funds

1MUTUAL FUNDS (FEES) REGULATIONS, 2000
2000/84.
Authority: These Regulations were made on 3rd November, 2000 by the Minister under
section 49(1) of the Mutual Funds Act.
Commencement: 13th November, 2000.
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Mutual Funds (Fees)
Regulations, 2000.
2. There shall be paid to the Securities Exchange, in respect of the
matters set out in the Schedule, the corresponding fees specified in
that Schedule.
Schedule.
1These Regulations were saved by section 58 of the Mutual Funds Act, 2002 (Act 2002-22).
